args.title: Fix issue 4424 in src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts generates the export filename using the current UTC date (at.toISOString().slice(0, 10)), rather than the user's local date, causing exports in the evening to show the next day's date. args.title: Fix issue 4429 in src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The duplication logic is in the POST /reports/:id/duplicate endpoint, where the copy's name is created by truncating `${source.name} (copy)` to a max length of 120. If the original name is close to 120 characters, this truncation causes the suffix to be replaced with '...' and loses '(copy)', making the duplicate name look identical and confusing users. The fix is to change name truncation to preserve the '(copy)' suffix even for long names.

args.title: Fix issue 4434 in src/components/UploadForm.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The UploadForm component holds the upload error message in state ('problem') and only clears it on successful submit or new upload. Changing the file sets the file state but does not clear the old error message. To fix, the onChange handler of the file input should also clear the 'problem' state to remove old errors immediately when the user selects a new file.
